visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with medium-length brown hair, dressed in a cream-colored coat and a grey pleated skirt, stands in front of a vibrant pink "CHIIKAWA SHOP" in Taipei. She holds a white paper bag while posing beside a massive white character illustration on the storefront's facade under bright natural daylight. (2) The woman holds up three plush toys with long rabbit ears in pastel colors in front of the shop. The scene transitions to an indoor living room where she holds two plushies close to her face, smiling broadly with squinted eyes and expressive hand gestures. (3) A digital ticket on a smartphone screen displays reservation details for the shop. The camera then moves inside the store, showcasing glass display cases and pink tiered shelves filled with numerous character-themed plush toys, stickers, and stationery. (4) The woman displays a large, transparent mesh shopping bag with pink handles. She is seen browsing the shelves, her hands reaching for specific "Taiwan limited" plushies. The lighting is bright and consistent with a retail studio environment. (5) Back at home, she sits on a grey sofa in a living room with purple curtains. She unboxes her purchases on a white circular coffee table, showcasing a "lucky" cat plushie and hanging a New Year character decoration on a dark wooden door.

(3) A distinct crinkling sound of plastic bags and the soft thud of items being handled trigger a phase shift as she picks out merchandise. Her voice exhibits expressive pitch variability and clear articulation. (4) The acoustic texture changes slightly as the scene moves to her home living room; the background music remains, but the room tone becomes drier. Sound effects like a digital chime emphasize the appearance of text on screen. (5) A high-pitched metallic jingle from a small bell on a plushie is heard clearly. The narrator provides a concluding message with a warm, friendly tone, accompanied by rhythmic music that fades out at the end.
